cases.name: ordinary-no-schema
cases.trigger: Compile/admit/evaluate with no assessor/origin
cases.expected: Success for the accepted ordinary profile; zero schema binding/issuance calls and no fabricated assessment.

cases.name: foreign-environment
cases.trigger: Use an equal-looking foreign environment
cases.expected: Reject before root/content getters or work; equality never admits authority.

cases.name: invalid-origin-without-advisor
cases.trigger: Supply original assessment without an available selected advisor
cases.expected: Reject under the accepted argument/profile policy; never ignore, downgrade or synthesize origin.

cases.name: owner-entry-failure
cases.trigger: Owner lifetime Enter throws
cases.expected: No root access/work; cleanup only acquired obligations; host retains untransferred resources.

cases.name: root-getter-order
cases.trigger: Owner availability fails before root access
cases.expected: Root/content getter spies remain untouched; release acquired admission obligation once.

cases.name: foreign-node
cases.trigger: Input predicate rejects a purported node
cases.expected: Reject before node contents/facts getters; do not infer membership from labels.

cases.name: ambiguous-node
cases.trigger: Two sources claim the same supplied node
cases.expected: Refuse before dispatch; no implicit owner choice or graph copy.

cases.name: no-authority-from-annotations
cases.trigger: Ordinary input exposes descriptive type annotations or purported foreign facts
cases.expected: Do not authenticate or attach schema provenance without selected advisor issuance/association.

cases.name: source-free
cases.trigger: Explicit empty operation membership
cases.expected: Source-free supported XPath/XQuery/named XSLT work succeeds; any node role still requires admission.

cases.name: separate-xslt-roles
cases.trigger: Distinct match/global admissions and shared admission variant
cases.expected: Both roles validated against exact operation; shared source leased once; global and match focus remain distinct.

cases.name: membership-token
cases.trigger: Reuse input from another operation with identical member list
cases.expected: Refuse before host dispatch; no descriptor/identity-label shortcut.

cases.name: duplicate-member
cases.trigger: Repeat an actual admission in the member set
cases.expected: Reject before acquiring raw leases or calling work.

cases.name: partial-acquisition
cases.trigger: Second source/admission fails
cases.expected: Release acquired prefix in reverse order; rejected resource cleanup remains with host; no work callback.

cases.name: primary-and-cleanup
cases.trigger: Acquisition/work/cancellation plus multiple cleanup failures
cases.expected: Preserve original exception object first and all cleanup failures in attempted reverse order; do not flatten.

cases.name: canceled-wait
cases.trigger: Cancel an external wait while raw callback is blocked
cases.expected: All admitted resources remain held until actual raw work completes; no waiter-owned cleanup.

cases.name: close-during-raw
cases.trigger: Close admission/session while raw work continues
cases.expected: Further guarded use refuses; resource release waits for raw ownership under selected owner contract.

cases.name: nested-operations
cases.trigger: Enter nested operations over overlapping admissions
cases.expected: Independent raw leases; inner completion cannot release outer ownership; enforce provider reentry scope.

cases.name: real-xmldb-owner
cases.trigger: Use actual BeginRead snapshot and persistent nodes
cases.expected: Retain/release actual reader/generation ownership with no eager source copy or product/store pin mutation.

cases.name: typed-regression
cases.trigger: Repeat existing typed evidence/PSVI/list/constructor controls after any lifetime extraction
cases.expected: Preserve original assessment, cache, provenance and refusal rules; ordinary path must not weaken schema admission.

cases.name: default-path-and-gates
cases.trigger: Compare existing ordinary APIs and qualify full candidate
cases.expected: No accidental legacy/default/constant/ABI change; all tests/gates and ordinary-path measurements pass on exact candidate.

additionalDrainControl.expected: Drain waits for actual raw completion after waiter cancellation/close; close and drain repeat without duplicate release; retain all cleanup errors.
